title: A communication-policy pilot latency budget
method: Synthetic medians for the same hypothetical workload under three configurations. Differences are illustrative and cannot be transferred to a mesh product or real service. Tail latency, throughput and resource consumption require separate measurements.
alt: A communication-policy pilot latency budget: Direct path 8 milliseconds, Encrypted mesh path 10 milliseconds, Mesh with policy 11 milliseconds. Illustrative inputs.
